_noteQ: Q (Queen's Wrath [unburrowed] / Prey Seeker [burrowed]) is a form-dependent skill where BOTH real-game variants deal damage, but the curated schema has only one flat 'hits' array per slot with no stance/OR-branching mechanism -- summing both would double-count two mutually-exclusive stances within a single combo node. Only Prey Seeker (burrowed) is curated: 'BurrowDamageTooltip' = NamedDataValue(BurrowedBaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(BurrowedBonusADRatio=0.25, mStat=2/mStatFormula=2=bonus AD) + StatByNamedDataValue(BurrowedAPRatio=0.7, mStat unset -> AP) -- WebSearch (mobafire/metabot current-patch data) confirms Prey Seeker deals 50/80/110/140/170 (+70% AP)(+25% bonus AD) physical damage, an EXACT match to BIN's BurrowedBaseDamage[20,50,80,110,140,170,200] indices 1-5 and both ratios; type Physical confirmed. Queen's Wrath (unburrowed, next-3-attacks empowerment) is NOT curated: its only named calc, 'TotalDamageTooltip', sums ONLY the AD-ratio term (StatByNamedDataValue on UnburrowedADRatio, matching wiki's 30/35/40/45/50% AD almost exactly) but never references the UnburrowedBaseDamage DataValue that also exists in the same DataValues array -- leaving real doubt about whether TotalDamageTooltip is a complete formula or omits a genuine flat component; the empowered-attack's own spell object (RekSaiQSpellPassive) carries raw mCoefficient/mCoefficient2 fields with no named GameCalculation at all, so there is no clean alternate source either. Left unresolved rather than risk a wrong/incomplete number.
_noteW: W (Unburrow, burrowed-form dismount burst): 'UnburrowDamage' = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(APRatio=0.8, mStat unset -> AP). An initial WebFetch of leagueoflegends.fandom.com/wiki/Rek'Sai/LoL showed stale/contradictory text describing this as '(+80% bonus AD)' Physical damage -- but that page's content did not match the BIN's mStat-absent (=AP) calc structure, and Rek'Sai's kit is otherwise 100% bonus-AD scaling (Q/E/R), which made a lone AP-scaling ability internally suspicious. A follow-up WebSearch against wiki.leagueoflegends.com's own live ability template confirmed Unburrow is genuinely MAGIC damage with an AP ratio -- the fandom mirror's text was simply outdated/mismatched. BIN structure (Magic, AP-scaling) is correct as originally auto-picked; no change made. W (unburrowed 'Burrow', going underground) has zero damage of its own -- correctly not represented.
_noteE: E (Furious Bite, unburrowed): 'BaseDamageCalculation' = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(BonusAD=0.6, mStat=2/mStatFormula=2=bonus AD) -- standard AD-scaling bite, Physical confirmed by wiki and by the explicit bonus-AD stat formula. A max-Fury variant exists ('EmpoweredDamageCalculation', a GameCalculationModified referencing BaseDamageCalculation with an EmpoweredRatio multiplier, converting to guaranteed-floor True damage per the wiki) but is conditional on Fury being fully stacked, not guaranteed every cast -- left uncurated, same conservative precedent as Volibear's conditional bite empowerment in a prior batch. E (burrowed 'Tunnel', dash + create tunnel entrances) has zero damage of its own -- correctly not represented.
_noteR: R (Void Rush): 'RBaseDamageCalc' = NamedDataValue(RBaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(ADRatio=1.0, mStat=2/mStatFormula=2=bonus AD) is the flat+AD impact term (Physical).
